game_title: Off By One Fixer – Berry Thicket Streak
game_concept: A quiz RPG set in Mystic Forest – Berry Thicket, a berry thicket: the beast tamer must handle bramble beasts while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Off By One Fixer: Fix range boundaries that skip or overshoot by one.
theme: Mystic Forest – Berry Thicket: a berry thicket
core_gameplay_loop: In Berry Thicket, repeat each round: Fix range boundaries that skip or overshoot by one. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the fixes value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 11 consecutive correct decisions about fixes to power up the beast tamer and open the heartwood tree.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 4 (applied tier): Off By One Fixer
